definition: a band wrapped around the wrist
description: Two young women stand facing each other on a park lawn at sunset, hands pressed together, laughing. In close-up one of them fastens a woven beaded band around the other's wrist and adjusts it. They then throw their arms around each other, one climbs onto the other's back and they spin around on the grass with the low sun behind them.
